schedule: Identical seed-shuffled per-output round-robin warmup; nine distinct route updates on every tick in every arm. Round-robin continues over 45. Other arms freeze nine candidates at warmup end and update all nine thereafter. Readout chooses one minimum-error-plus-width route per output from the active pool.
pruning: Residual pruning ranks each output's routes by local prequential squared error plus key width; it never penalizes shared input. Random pruning is seeded without outcomes. Overlap pruning greedily selects one route per output in three rounds with a 0.25 penalty per previously selected route sharing input. Retired count tables remain frozen for audit; no storage saving is claimed.
data: Reuse the fixed independent/interacting Boolean generator with fresh seeds: hidden channel permutations, train excludes 111, nuisance copying 0.9, frozen ID/nuisance-reversal/novel/intervention splits. No oracle dependencies enter any learner.
additional_gates: All interacting cases must retain the true shared dependency routes in the residual active pool. Every matched arm must execute exactly 4608 outcome route updates (13824 count/error/observation value mutations); residual pool must shrink from 45 to 9 after warmup. Replay and resource integrity must pass.
stop_rule: Retain every result and failed gate. No coefficient, seed, threshold, candidate or dataset tuning after registered execution. A positive gate is a bounded component result, not production promotion.
scope: Finite supervised route selection on stationary Boolean tasks; no spiking advantage, physical energy, anonymous concepts, real-data access or production integration. Equal outcome updates do not imply equal scheduling work or CPU time.
